source_rules.rule: Choice index5 is Composite Min. The unchanged inherited itemStateChanged sets CompositeProjection=Min before testing inversion, invokes ij.jar:InvertAllLuts iff Min and the actual active processor is not inverted, then calls setMode(COMPOSITE) and updateAndDraw.

isInvertedLut caches the result and returns inverted iff there is no RGB-sum increase from i-1 to i for i=1..254. The 254-to255 pair is excluded; constant tables are inverted. Observe the actual processor/base table and cache-sensitive changes, not a guessed current-channel table.
ImagePlus.isInvertedLut reads its ip. Displayed hyperstack setPosition delegates to StackWindow; setSlice installs the selected stored LUT only while the current mode is COMPOSITE.
Selector C/Z/T and imp.position update before setSlice, preserving correct source binding on each macro Stack.setChannel.

getLut on a composite reads the stored current channel LUT; setLut updates CompositeImage then updateAndDraw; is("Inverting LUT") reads ImagePlus.ip; Stack.setChannel delegates to ImagePlus.setPosition. Stored channel tables and active processor color model must be recorded independently.

The exact bundled macro transforms every stored channel table through its original HSV double arithmetic and round, retains per-channel ranges through setChannelLut, then deliberately selects channel1 (native C0). With requested Min it leaves Min if the final actual processor classifies inverted; otherwise it changes the property to Max. Do not replace macro execution with a host-computed table or algebraic shortcut.

A real bound window makes updateAndDraw execute updateImage. Color/Gray and singleton paths differ from multi-channel composition. Entering Composite from another mode resets flags true; staying Composite retains them. setChannelLut resets current-channel tracking and installs the supplied LUT on ip. Gray navigation does not install the stored current-channel LUT.
runMacroFile directly calls Macro_Runner on the current thread.
Macro file/resource loading and Interpreter.run complete synchronously before the handler returns; record the returned/aborted macro state and do not add an arbitrary sleep as a completion oracle.
Offscreen real paint may update/get the image and therefore affect caches. Preserve handler-before-readback state separately from after-paint state.

fixture_contract.projection_null_meaning: No CompositeProjection property; normal Sum baseline. Explicit per-case Max is a real input property, not an action result.

These are source predictions requiring new hosted observations before any product policy decision.
